locations.name: Bridgeport
locations.blurb: The Freehold city where the Godsfall River meets Godsfall Bay, and the party's home port.

locations.name: Dalraven
locations.blurb: A walled frontier town at the mouth of the Raven River on Godsfall Bay, north of Bridgeport.

locations.name: Funnis
locations.blurb: A woodlands Ursinor settlement in the Whistle Woods, in the foothills below the Livingstone Mountains.

locations.name: Wexford
locations.blurb: A walled Aelfaen woodland town at the heart of the Wexwood Forest, south of Bridgeport.

locations.name: Cairnellah
locations.blurb: A walled royal port on Godsfall Bay, with a castle in the northwest corner, a long line of docks, and an airship anchorage beneath an ancient dragon palace.

locations.name: Pistil Point
locations.blurb: A small walled fishing village on a peninsula between the Sea of Zephyrys and Nereth Bay, in the shadow of the Grand Preceptory of Saint Eccles.

locations.name: Trellen Gap
locations.blurb: A palisaded frontier hamlet deep in the Great Forest of the Duchy of Rhundel, far to the east of this map.
